thread:
Ana: Heads up — need to map out release gates and constrained handoffs for the midyear roadmap. Who owns gating criteria for the Redwood Optimize launch? Need cross-team dependencies and a sequencing table by EOW.
Tariq: I can own runtime gating (perf benchmarks + fallbacks). Will need infra support for Dedicated capacity tests.
Maria: Platform can run capacity tests Wed-Fri. What's the target SLA?
Ana: Target end-to-end p95 <350ms on hosted baseline, and <20% token cost uplift vs baseline for quantized model. Also fallback policy: degrade to smaller variant if latency > SLO.
Lee: Design will finalize prompts + eval set by Thursday. We need to lock prompt set before performance tests.
Sam: Product ops: I'll assemble the sequencing table. Quick ask — are customer pilot contracts required before Dedicated rollout?
Tariq: Yes for Dedicated. Sales/legal to confirm. Also need region availability to be listed.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: canary job queued for infra/tests tomorrow 08:00 UTC
Maria: Noted. I'll add regions: us-west1, eu-central, ap-southeast1 on the matrix.
Ana: Suggested sequencing (rough):
1) prompt & eval locked
2) perf + infra capacity tests
3) model quantization validation
4) canary with opt-in customers
5) GA for hosted
6) Dedicated reserved capacity and Private package
Is that ok?
Tariq: Agree but move step 3 explicitly between 2 and 4 — quantization must be validated before any canary.
Lee: Design: also add 'UX rollback plan' step before GA.
Sam: I'll create the table. Action items: Ana assign prompt owners; Lee create rollback copy; Maria schedule infra slots; Tariq run perf benchmark; Sam coordinate pilot invites.
Ana: @Lee assign me for prompt owners. @Maria can you pick slots? Can everyone add availability to the sheet: https://docs.google.com/xxxxx
Maria: Done — added Wed-Fri slots and notes about GPU types.
Tariq: Started perf run: logs at http://internal-ci/12345. Initial p95 looks like 420ms on 8k context for baseline.
Ana: That's above target. Tariq — can you try batching profile + KV cache warmup and rerun? Also tag any regressions.
Tariq: Will do. ETA EOD today.
Sam: I'll send a short risk register to execs with the gating criteria and mitigation (fallback policies + canary thresholds).
Ana: :thumbsup: Let's treat model quantization validation as a blocking item for Dedicated. If quantization fails, fallback to larger instance or skip Dedicated for initial GA.
Lee: UX notes: add clear customer messaging about possible fallbacks and token cost variance.
incident-bot: incident-bot: new incident created if canary error rate > 3% for 30m
Maria: Mapping file updated: /shared/roadmaps/midyear-gates.csv
Tariq: Perf rerun finished: p95 330ms after KV warmup and small batch tuning. Uploading artifacts.
Ana: Great. Closing loop — Sam please set a canary threshold: p95 <400ms and error rate <1% for 24h. If met, proceed to GA for hosted.
Sam: Will do, putting on calendar.
Lee: I'll prepare microcopy for fallback modal.
Ana: Thanks everyone. We'll review final gating checklist in the cross-team sync Friday 16:00 UTC.
